Əlønĝačhəd-måčhetṭə.definition:
The 17th of the [hardest] words in here. (Maybe)

[Meaning]: A strong machete.

[Pronounciation]: Ae-lonch-gaw-shed-ma-cha-tei
Əlønĝačhəd-måčhetṭə.example: When the man used the Əlønĝačhəd-måčhetṭə to cut the sand, he [accidentally] made a wyıngaṭ łanßuuaṭ go [down the hill]. [Unfortunately], in the half that was affected, it also destroyed the pẅiŋs-łiftĥ.
